title: Russian warship hit by suspected Ukrainian drone at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say
summary: A Russian navy corvette docked at the Benghazi naval base ​in eastern Libya was hit on Sunday by a suspected Ukrainian sea drone, according to local officials, in what appeared to be the latest attack linked to the Russia-Ukraine war in the North African nation. Hours later, a cargo ship was also hit by a sea drone in a second attack off Benghazi on Sunday…
